import ssl, socket, threading, time

context = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)
context.load_cert_chain("/app/ssl/server.pem")  # combined PEM: key + cert

server = socket.socket()
server.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
server.bind(("127.0.0.1", 8443))
server.listen(1)

def serve():
    conn, _ = server.accept()
    try:
        sconn = context.wrap_socket(conn, server_side=True)
        sconn.recv(1024)
        sconn.close()
    except Exception:
        pass
    finally:
        server.close()

t = threading.Thread(target=serve, daemon=True)
t.start()
time.sleep(0.3)

client_ctx = ssl.create_default_context(cafile="/app/ssl/server.crt")  # self-signed as CA
with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", 8443), timeout=5) as sock:
    with client_ctx.wrap_socket(sock, server_hostname="dev-internal.company.local") as ssock:

        print("Peer CN:", ssock.getpeercert()["subject"][0][1][1])
t.join(timeout=5)
EOF
